√kvaṇ 'sound'
present: [1.] kvaṇati 
[perfect: cakvāṇa akvāṇīt kvaṇiṣyati kvaṇitā ]
verbal: kvaṇita 
secondary: causative: kvaṇayati etc. 
derivatives: -kvaṇana

√kvath 'boil'
present: [1.] dīná etc. B.+ 
[perfect: cakvātha akvathīt kvathiṣyati kvathitā ]
verbal: kvathita 
secondary: causative: kvāthayati etc. S.+ kvāthyate etc. E.+ 
derivatives: kvatha kvathana C. kvātha C. kvāthayitavya C.
